### God, Touch Our Hearts
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/god-touch-our-hearts
Passage: 1 Samuel 10:26
Points:
- The infinite God intimately reached out to make personal contact with human hearts.
- A touch from the Lord penetrates past exterior layers straight to the core of our being.
- In profound condescension, the Almighty comes extraordinarily close without consuming us.
- Believers should persistently pray for God to touch their hearts anew for His glory.

### Are You Hiding by the Baggage?
Author: Tonilee Adamson and Bobbye Brooks (Daily Disciples Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-apirl-6-11572594.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 10:22
Points:
- God frequently calls people to responsibilities and purposes they were not seeking on their own.
- Even after experiencing internal spiritual transformation, feelings of inadequacy can cause believers to hide.
- Closing the gap between God's inward calling and outward living requires patience and character growth.
- Facing daily trials and exercising self-control prepares believers to step out of hiding in God's timing.
